s: When was the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana officially approved by the Union Cabinet?
x: The Union Cabinet approved the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana on 16 July 2025, for six years from 2025-26, covering 100 low-productivity districts. 1 February 2025 is the Budget 2025-26 day on which it was only announced; it was launched on 11 October 2025.

s:
Consider the following statements about Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY):

I. It is a Central Sector Sub-scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada for formalization of the fisheries sector and supporting fisheries micro and small enterprises.

II. It will be implemented with an investment of over 6,000 crores over a period of next 4 years from FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27 in all States and Union Territories.

III. It aims to provide one-time incentive to beneficiaries for purchasing aquaculture insurance.
Which of the above statements are correct?
x: PM-MKSSY is a Central Sector sub-scheme under PMMSY to formalise the fisheries sector and support fisheries micro and small enterprises (I); it involves an investment of over ₹6,000 crore over four years, FY 2023-24 to 2026-27, in all States/UTs (II); and it gives a one-time incentive for buying aquaculture insurance (III). So all three are correct.

s: Which organization is implementing the "Ayushman Bharat Scheme"?
x: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is implemented by the National Health Authority (NHA). The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare is the parent ministry, not the implementing agency; the Ministry of Ayush and ICMR have no role in running it.
